Simple Published Simulation Replication + Zika Dispersion Comparisons

Discussion

Stan models

I replicated a simple simulation setting from BYN PLOSOne 2020 and compared the performance of edgeR and my Stan models on this data set. The setting is just a two-group comparison, with baseline means and dispersions sampled from edgeR estimates produced by a large real data set and FC simulated from 1.5 + exp(1). There are no random effects.

  • Stan model with negative binomial response and estimated dispersion is ok
    • Better logFC estimates than edgeR
    • Similar ROC to edgeR
    • Liberal FDR control, where edgeR is conservative
    • Overestimates (truly) large dispersions, where edgeR underestimates
  • Stan model with Poisson response is quite poor

Zika ribo-seq data set

I compared dispersion estimates produced by DESeq2 for RNA and RPF samples separately. The estimates do not appear strongly correlated.
